# Agentic Workflows Notes

This repository can adopt Agentic Workflows from awesome-copilot.

Reference:
- https://github.com/github/awesome-copilot
- https://github.github.com/gh-aw

## Setup

1. Install extension:
   - gh extension install github/gh-aw
2. Add workflow source markdown files into this folder.
3. Compile workflows:
   - gh aw compile
4. Commit both source .md and generated .lock.yml files.

## Useful Commands

- gh aw run <workflow>
- gh aw status
- gh aw logs

## Suggested Starter Workflows

- relevance-check
- daily-issues-report
